title: Tusnády's problem in Lean 4
description:
Lean 4 formalization accompanying Nicola Wengiel's Resolving Tusnády's Problem. For each fixed dimension d ≥ 2, the worst-case combinatorial discrepancy of N-point sets for closed lower orthants and bounded closed axis-parallel boxes has order (log N)d − 1/2. Positive constants and the threshold for N depend only on d. The software combines Wengiel's lower bound for d ≥ 3, Zhewei Wei's planar lower bound and Aleksandar Nikolov's matching upper bound.

The joint theorem Tusnady.Integrated.main_sharp_order uses only the standard axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The archive includes source, reproduction instructions and verification records. The polytopes and algorithmic consequences in the paper are outside the formalization's scope.

The integrated modules from Wei's planar formalization preserve their MIT license and unchanged proof bodies, with local adaptations to import paths and attribution headers.
